en.hubeali: Al Husayn Bin Muhammad Bin Al Sayyari, from Ali Bin Asbad, from one of his companions who said,
‘Abu Abdullah<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘Honour the bread’. It was said, ‘And what is its honouring?’ He<sup>asws</sup> said: ‘When it is placed, so do not wait with it for something else’.
en.sarwar: 4. Al-Husayn from Muhammad has narrated from al-Sayyariy from Ali ibn Asbat from certain persons of his people who has said the following:

“Abu ‘Abd Allah, ‘Alayhi al-Salam, has said, ‘You must treat bread with reverence.’ It was asked, ‘What is treating it with reverence?’ He (the Imam) said, ‘When it is made available one must not wait for others.’”
